acceptance.behavior: The public /login route establishes the session and successful profile authority routes the remembered identity to /dashboard.
The responsive login form presents an unchecked Remember me control with trusted-device guidance and never pre-fills a retained email address.
Supabase Auth remains the durable identity authority while an opted-in refresh session survives a reconstructed browser context.
Remember Me changes only cookie lifetime; the existing durable profile role and onboarding state continue to determine the post-login destination.
The browser journey writes the required exact-revision desktop, mobile, trace, accessibility, and result artifacts after execution.
One Playwright spec validates default session cookies, opted-in durable cookies, browser-context restoration, profile authority, responsive UI, and accessibility.
The labeled checkbox is associated with device-safety help, mobile overflow is rejected, and axe analysis rejects serious or critical violations.
Sessions are browser-session scoped by default, durable expiry is retained only after explicit consent, and legacy saved email data is removed.
